episodes.title: The Seven Deadly Sins
episodes.summary: The third princess of the Kingdom of Liones, Elizabeth, finds Meliodas, who is the owner of the Boar Hat bar and is also one of the Seven Deadly Sins. With her identity exposed, she is pursued by Twigo whom Meliodas quickly defeats. The princess joins him on his journey to find the other Deadly Sins in order to defeat the Holy Knights, who have orchestrated a coup d'état and have overthrown the king.

episodes.title: The Sword of the Holy Knight
episodes.summary: Gilthunder, thus preventing the village from making the Bernia ale, which was their prime source of income. After innumerable unsuccessful attempts of the villagers to remove the sword with which the source was blocked, Meliodas easily removes the object. A celebration is held at the Boar Hat, and Meliodas was hailed as a savior by Bernia's villagers. Gilthunder, wanting to confirm whether the removal of his sword was an accident, threw a spear imbued with his power toward the town. Meliodas, however, easily stops and throws the spear back, destroying Fort Solgales.

episodes.title: Sin of the Sleeping Forest
episodes.summary: Meliodas, Hawk and Elizabeth travel to the Forest of White Dreams that even Holy Knights avoid. There, the Prankster Imps that inhabit the Forest of White Dreams attempt to confuse them by impersonating Hawk and Elizabeth in order to lead them away. After defeating them, they follow them and find the Serpent's Sin of Envy, Diane sleeping in the forest. Gilthunder suddenly arrives and binds all of them with his lightning magic. Meliodas battles Gilthunder, purposely allows the Holy Knight to slash him, and under the pretense of dying due to the grave wound, acquires information about the whereabouts of two members of the Seven Deadly Sins, King and Ban, as his apparent last wish.

episodes.title: A Little Girl's Dream
episodes.summary: Having discovered the whereabouts of Ban and King, Diane throws Gilthunder out of the forest, and Meliodas, Hawk and Elizabeth, now joined by Diane, head toward the Baste Dungeon, where Ban is imprisoned. They later arrive at Dalmary Town where Meliodas is treated by Dana. Diane and Elizabeth begin to argue and discuss about the aspects in which they envy each other. They are suddenly attacked by the Holy Knight Friesia, who tries to destroy the entire town along with the Deadly Sins, but Diane quickly destroys all of her insects. Concurrently, Ban escapes from his cell in the Baste Dungeon, and is stopped by Jericho, who tries to subdue him. Dana unexpectedly reveals that the medicine Meliodas drank was a deadly poison as Golgius appears out of the blue.

episodes.title: Even If You Should Die
episodes.summary: Golgius appears and attempts to take Elizabeth and Meliodas' sword back to Liones. Whilst attempting to take the sword, Meliodas awakens, with no effect of the poison showing, proceeding to blast an aura that causes Golgius to make a hasty retreat. Meliodas and Elizabeth set off to Baste Dungeon afterwards, however, they are stopped by a confused Diane, who after hearing the sound of a bell, attacks the group. They try to run away from the berserk Diane, involving a pair of shepherds along the way, however Meliodas soon succumbs to the same bell, and begins to fight Diane. Meanwhile in Baste Dungeon, Ban is shown wandering around after having dealt with Jericho. It is not long before he is found by Jude of the Weird Fangs, who promptly stabs Ban in the chest.

episodes.title: The Poem of Beginnings
episodes.summary: Elizabeth and Meliodas need the holy knights Friesia and Ruin sorted to get the dungeon. A harbinger indicates that a disaster on its way.

episodes.title: A Touching Reunion
episodes.summary: Meliodas picks the ggroup's next destination to be the rumored location of the King, the Capital of the Dead.

episodes.title: The Fearsome Pursuer
episodes.summary: King has a final confrontation with Ban, finishing him off with Ban being frozen, with Elaine making an appearance, never showing herself to King. A holy knight Guila battles it out against Meliodas, Diane and Elizabeth. Ban continues his flashbacks with Elaine and the Fairy forest, at the foutain of youth.

episodes.title: Dark Pulse
episodes.summary: The battle with the King comes to a close as he overpowers Guila with Chastiefol. Their time in the Capital of the Dead now over, Ban and Elaine have one more close moment, before being bid a farewell by Ellen and Luigi, who are revealed to have been ghosts this entire time...

episodes.title: The Vaizel Fighting Festival
episodes.summary: The Byzel fighting festival commences! After the initial brawl only leaves 8 people standing. The three first rounds unravel with some interesting displays of power and a few surprises.

episodes.title: Pent-up Feelings
episodes.summary: It's Meriodas vs. Ban in a a fight that shakes the ground beneath their feet. The semifinal rounds end up with the sins gaining one new friend and remembering an old one. Everything is ready for the final match while a storm starts brewing in the horizon.

episodes.title: Bloodcurdling Cannon
episodes.summary: The final round draws to a close. The Holy Knights descend upon the sins giving them some new powers and improved equipment. The Deadly Sins are pushed against the ropes.

episodes.title: The Angel of Destruction
episodes.summary: Meliodas is freed and the power of the Captain sin makes its debut. Possessed by a strange darkness, Meliodas assaults both enemies and allies until he clashes against Hellbram, the two of them fight mercilessly.

episodes.title: A Reader of Books
episodes.summary: News of an armored giant walking around the mountains reach the holy knights and they quickly send an assassination squad to deal with it. In the meantime, Meliodas's group also finds out about the mysterious giant. The holy knight team, the sins, and the giant clash in three-way battle with a very interesting outcome…

episodes.title: Unholy Knight
episodes.summary: The sins confront a strange demonic being. Meliodas is about to deal the final blow when he loses heart and stops attacking. In the meantime, Elisabeth discovers some facts about Meliodas's past. In the end, Elizabeth rushes to the battleground and her words give Meliodas the courage to fight to his full potential. When the sins inspect the dead body of the monster they find out it was some kind of hybrid between human and demon.

episodes.title: The Legends, Provoked
episodes.summary: Hendriksen and Hellbram make their first attempt to bring back the demon clan using the handle of Meliodas's sword, but the experiment fails and they appear to be missing one ingredient. Far away from there, Meliodas's group is taking a break from all the fighting…

episodes.title: The First Sacrifice
episodes.summary: Hendriksen and some of his guards welcome Arthur and his companion, a short person covered with a cloak. Meanwhile King finds a way to transport Diane and him to the city of Liones.

episodes.title: Even If It Costs Me My Life
episodes.summary: After a fight starts, Howzer and Guila combine their powers to protect Diane and Guila's little brother from the combined forces of Githunder, Helbram, Dreyfus, and Jericho.

episodes.title: The Fairy King Waits in Vain
episodes.summary: The King reminisces over some old memories of a time Diane and King spent together when Diane was still a giant child. Back to the present, King fights Hellbram, while in a different location Hendriksen fights Arthur.

episodes.title: The Courage Charm
episodes.summary: Gilthunder arrives to support Hendriksen against Meliodas, Arthur tries to keep Hendriksen busy while Meliodas fights Gilthunder, but has to withdraw leading to a three way fight...

episodes.title: The Looming Threat
episodes.summary: Ban explores the catacombs under the city. Merlin and the other sins go to the chamber where the king Baltra and Elizabeth are being held captive. Dreyfus has a confession.

episodes.title: What I Can Do for You
episodes.summary: Ban attempts to kill Meliodas, but is stopped by Hawk. Meliodas and the sins corner Hendriksen and prepare to take him down.

episodes.title: Despair Descends
episodes.summary: Hendriksen turns into an incredibly powerful monster. As Hendriksen overpowers both the sins and the holy knights only Meliodas is still standing...

episodes.title: The Heroes
episodes.summary: The group combines forces to defeat Hendriksen while Meliodas uses his ultimate technique. Following Hendriksen's defeat, the citizens of Liones saw a strange bird-like creature flying north. The sins and Elizabeth leave for their next adventure!

episodes.title: Revival of the Demon Clan
episodes.summary: After the defeat of demonized Hendrickson, The Seven Deadly Sins are commended for their bravery and courage by King Bartra. However, just before the ceremony, Ban and King leave. Earlier, Ban had told Meliodas that he is quitting the Seven Deadly Sins. As Ban leaves the Boar Hat Bar, King sees him and asks where he is going. Ban tells King that he wants to go to the Fairy King Forest. King then accompanies Ban on his journey. Meanwhile, it is reveals that Hendrickson has survived the assault from the Sins and he is shocked upon seeing Dreyfus alive. Dreyfus then summons the Commandments, ten demonized warriors who intend to destroy the Sins.

episodes.title: Existence and Proof
episodes.summary: The Ten Commandments are in the process of recovering their magical powers and fly to the Kingdom of Edinburgh in the east. Meanwhile, Jericho is discovered following Ban and King on the journey to the Fairy King's Forest. In the forest, the fairy people call King a traitor because he left the Fairy King's Forest 700 years ago, his absence allowing the forest to be almost entirely destroyed, while Ban is called the new Fairy King because he planted the last Sacred Tree seed that Elaine entrusted to him. Diane and Elizabeth admit to each other their love for King and Meliodas respectively. Meanwhile Gowther, believing he needs to experience love, alters Guila's memories so she forgets Zeal is her brother and thinks Gowther is her boyfriend, while Zeal, who Gowther considers a barrier between himself and Guila, loses his entire memory. Gowthers manipulation of their memory enrages Diane and she attacks him without hesitation.

episodes.title: Sacred Treasure Lostvayne
episodes.summary: Diane confronts Gowther after he manipulates Guila and Zeal's memories. with the return of the Demon Clan, new threats descend upon allied clans.

episodes.title: The Ten Commandments on the Move
episodes.summary: King struggles to fend off the giant Albion sent to destroy the Fairy King's forest. Galand of the ten commandments appears before Meliodas.

episodes.title: Overwhelming Violence
episodes.summary: Galand, the truth of the ten commandments gets teleported to The Seven Deadly Sins. After his overwhelming power is revealed, Merlin realizes how terrifying the situation is.

episodes.title: The Great Holy Knight Atones for His Sins
episodes.summary: Hendrickson thought to have been defeated in a battle against Meliodas, aids Gilthunder and the Holy Knights against a powerful Gray Demon.

episodes.title: Where Memories Lead
episodes.summary: An injured Diane awakens, having trouble remembering her comrades. with her memories fading she heads for Magedoza, home of the Giant Clan.

episodes.title: The Druids' Holy Land
episodes.summary: Meliodas and others head to Megadozer in hopes of finding Diane. Meanwhile, a confused Diane encounters Galand of the Ten commandments once again.

episodes.title: The Promise with the Loved One
episodes.summary: Acknowledging his lack of strength to face the Ten Commandments, Meliodas vigorously trains with the Druids of Istar to regain his sealed powers back.

episodes.title: What We Lacked
episodes.summary: Ban reflects on his past after returning to his childhood home in Ravens. Meliodas's allies train for their inevitable war with the ten commandments.

episodes.title: Father and Son
episodes.summary: A frail Zhivago reunites with Ban, his long lost adopted son. Meanwhile, a wary King confronts Meliodas about his true intentions.

episodes.title: Where Love is Found
episodes.summary: After a brief encounter with Meliodas, the ten commandments begin their attack on Britannia. A resurrected Elaine appears before Ban.

episodes.title: Farewell, My Beloved Thief
episodes.summary: A revived but possessed Elaine attacks Ban, as Melascula and Galand of the ten commandments emerge to destroy those in their path.

episodes.title: Master of the Sun
episodes.summary: Jericho carries severely injured Ban and Elaine on her back while escaping from Galand and Melascula before stumbling into a bar deep inside a cave.

episodes.title: A Horrifying Confession
episodes.summary: Gloxinia and Drole of the ten commandments lure strong fighters to Vaizel by offering to grant any wish to the winner of their Great Fight Festival.

episodes.title: Death Trap Labyrinth
episodes.summary: An elaborate trap-laden deadly maze constructed by Drole begins to weed out the weaker challengers that have gathered for the great fight festival.

episodes.title: Legendary Figures
episodes.summary: The surviving challengers of the great fight festival are split into pairs and made to face each other in a tag team battle.

episodes.title: For Whom Does That Light Shine?
episodes.summary: King and Diane continue their battle against opponents summoned by Gloxinia and Drole. Escanor refuses to fight against his fellow ally Gowther.

episodes.title: Meliodas vs. The Ten Commandments
episodes.summary: The awakening of the ten commandments and beginning of the end of the kingdom of Britannia and the outbreak of the holy war. Now how will our heroes save Britannia from the hands of the ten commandments and from the demon lord.

episodes.title: In Search of Hope
episodes.summary: With Meliodas rendered powerless, Ban asks to be transported back so he can aid him in his fight against Estarossa and the other ten commandments.

episodes.title: Certain Warmth
episodes.summary: While caring for Meliodas, Elizabeth encounters a former Great Holy Knight thought to have perished long ago by the hands of Dreyfus and Hendrickson.

episodes.title: Return of the Sins
episodes.summary: With Ban and the holy knights paralyzed by Estarossa's powers, Escanor shows up to thwart the fall of Liones at the hands of the ten commandments.

episodes.title: The Hero Rises!
episodes.summary: As the situation inside Liones castle becomes even more dire, Merlin freed from Galand's commandment of truth, reappears in her former form.

episodes.title: As Long as You Are Here
episodes.summary: Determined to kill his former leader for betraying their clan 3,000 years ago, Fraudrin takes on a newly resurrected darker, more powerful Meliodas.

episodes.title: The Light That Disperses Darkness
episodes.summary: The demons are collecting human souls, whilst Estarossa is recovering from the battle with Escanor. Pelio discovers that humans are being given to the demons, who are defeated by Meliodas. The King chooses the next Great Holy Knight.

episodes.title: Memories of the Holy War
episodes.summary: King and Diane take refuge in the Fairy King's Forest to escape the Ten Commandments. But Gloxinia and Drole find them after a peaceful interlude.

episodes.title: Those Without Light
episodes.summary: Looking like Gloxinia and Drole, King and Diane are transported back to Britannia 3,000 years ago. There they meet Meliodas, who's fighting for Stigma.

episodes.title: The Ten Commandments vs. The Four Archangels
episodes.summary: Enraged by the events demons attack but Seriel and Tarmiel shows up and wipes out a large number of them in an instant. But as Ludociel joins the battle they are overpowered.Gowther and Melascula enters the stigma headquarters and takes over Nerobasta.

episodes.title: Emotional Maelstrom
episodes.summary: As Elizabeth succeeds in pushing back the indura form Gowther and Melascula are upto something in stigma headquarters, amidst of that Round and other humans attacks and kills everyone in stigma. As the gates open a person appears and gowther starts behaving differently..

episodes.title: We Call That Love
episodes.summary: Diane learns of the back-story of Gowther and makes a promise. King faces his final test in the realm and must make a crucial choice that Gloxinia faced 3000 years ago.

episodes.title: Deadly Sins Unite!
episodes.summary: Diane in the form of Drone goes against Zeldris the executioner but soon she realises his magnitude of power. After passing the test Diane and King unite with the rest of the sins.

episodes.title: The Doll Seeks Love
episodes.summary: Gowther's past memories resurface as he is reminded by the magical heart given to him by his master. Desperate to forget them, Gowther flees and tries to erase his memories, but The Seven Deadly Sins won't make it easy for him to do so.

episodes.title: The Cursed Lovers
episodes.summary: Merlin starts looking for Arthur but is trapped by Zeldris. Sins celebrate to their reunion but Elizabeth seems to be worried when Diane tells her about goddess Elizabeth. Merlin's condition is worsened but Elizabeth cures her and in that brief time she meets Zeldris who tells her something which in turn makes Meliodas extremely worried.

episodes.title: That is Our Way of Life
episodes.summary: Sins come to know about the tragic lives of Meliodas and Elizabeth. They decide to go to the walled city of Coland where none other than Zeldris shows up...

episodes.title: The Hateful Cannot Rest
episodes.summary: The party heads to the city of Coland to dispel the distortion protecting Camelot. When Meliodas is trapped in darkness, they must fight without him.

episodes.title: Love is a Maiden's Power
episodes.summary: Trapped in Melascula's magic, Meliodas breaks the magic at the cost of his emotions. Out of cocoon comes a very different Meliodas who will be confronted by the mightiest of the sin.

episodes.title: The Almighty vs. The Greatest Evil
episodes.summary: As things have escalated quickly this will be the final showdown among the strongest to prove who is better WRATH or PRIDE...

episodes.title: A New Threat
episodes.summary: Meliodas still unconscious after the fight with escanor, while Chandler proceeds to claim back his old student..

episodes.title: To Our Captain
episodes.summary: Chandler, Meliodas' former mentor, aids Zendris. He infiltrates the Boar Hat to capture Meliodas, but the Deadly Sins stand in his way.

episodes.title: Seven Deadly Sins End
episodes.summary: King prepares to face Chandler, who's returned in his demonic form. Gloxinia and Drole appear, risking their lives so the Deadly Sins can escape.

episodes.title: Our Choices
episodes.summary: Meliodas disbands the Deadly Sins and departs with Elizabeth. But his companions aren't going to let him go without a fight, and Hawk holds the key.

episodes.title: March of the Saints
episodes.summary: Merlin faces Zeldris, whom Meliodas has ordered to gather the Commandments. Margaret, Hendrickson and Dreyfus continue their search for Gilthunder.

episodes.title: The Holy War Accord
episodes.summary: Having taken over Margaret's body, Ludociel appears in Liones and declares a holy war against the Demon Clan. Chandler searches for Elizabeth.

episodes.title: Child of Hope
episodes.summary: In Camelot, Arthur searches for the Holy Sword Excalibur alone. Ludociel warns Escanor to give up his Grace of Sunshine, on pain of death.

episodes.title: Beginning of the Holy War
episodes.summary: Inside Camelot, Arthur makes his last stand against Meliodas and the others. Merlin comes to his rescue, but not before he falls under Cusack's spell.

episodes.title: War-torn Britannia
episodes.summary: The new Holy War commences as the allied forces of Stigma face off against the Demon Clan. Derieri decides to surrender her Commandment to Zeldris.

episodes.title: The One Twisted by Darkness
episodes.summary: Sensing Elizabeth's magic, Derieri appears before the Stigma army. Estarossa follows her, but Sariel and Tarmiel have other plans for him.

episodes.title: Rampaging Love
episodes.summary: Estarossa professes his love for Elizabeth. When he loses control after absorbing three of the Commandments, Stigma's army faces him in a final battle.

episodes.title: From Purgatory
episodes.summary: Ban searches in Purgatory for his best friend and captain emotions meanwhile in Camelot the assault force tries to stop Meliodas from becoming the new Demon King and the rescue team finds Elizabeth´s life is at stake.

episodes.title: A Meeting with the Unknown
episodes.summary: Reunited once again, Ban and Meliodas prepare to face the Demon King, who they suspect holds the key to their escape from purgatory.

episodes.title: A Single-Minded Love
episodes.summary: With Wild now an ally, Meliodas brings Zeldris` tragic past to light as the newly formed trio make their way towards the Demon King.

episodes.title: The Victims of the Holy War
episodes.summary: Meliodas grapples with suddenly losing his memories of Estarossa. Zeldris, Chandler and Cusack threaten to overpower Marlin and the others.

episodes.title: The Tragic Strike
episodes.summary: Gowther reveals that his creator, the real Gowther, cast a forbidden spell on Mael and all those who knew him to end the Holy War 3,000 years ago.

episodes.title: Confront Despair!!
episodes.summary: Mael defeated Derieri and took her commandment, giving Mael access to four commandments, but he isn`t done yet and seeks to take all ten. Gowther challenges Mael in order to protect his companions. Diane too arrives to fight Mael, but Mael`s final form is overwhelming. Thus Diane, King, and Gowther begin their special technique.

episodes.title: Hope, Conflict, and Despair
episodes.summary: Mael has become a strange figure by fusing with four commandments. King was temporarily cornered in front of Mael`s mighty power, but he awakens as "Fairy King Harlequin" and wields his true power. King, who can now activate multiple spirit spears at the same time, finally corners Mael. However, Gowther regrets his actions and seeks a chance to save Mael. Gowther then chose to "invade" and confront Mael`s spiritual world.

episodes.title: The Doorway to Hope
episodes.summary: Meliodas, Ban, and Wild finally confront the Demon King in purgatory. To escape from purgatory they must get past the Demon King who guards the gate. However, they struggle in their effort, for the Demon King has the ability to steal their attacks.

episodes.title: That Which Gathers
episodes.summary: Chandler and Cusack merge to form the all-powerful Original Demon. Merlin gives up any hope of victory, but Mael and King soon come to her aid.

episodes.title: The Salvation of the Sun
episodes.summary: As Meliodas absorbs every last one of the Ten Commandments, Merlin attempts a forbidden spell to stop the birth of the new Demon King.

episodes.title: The One Who Stands Against a God
episodes.summary: Merlin`s spell thwarts Meliodas` transformation. The Holy War seems to be over, but Elizabeth senses something is still terribly wrong.

episodes.title: We'll All Be Your Strength
episodes.summary: Escaping purgatory, Ban faces the Demon King, who now possesses Meliodas' body. Elizabeth and the others make their way into the spirit world.

episodes.title: The End of a Long Journey
episodes.summary: Peace returns to the Kingdom of Liones. Although Elizabeth is still under a curse, Meliodas assures her there is a way to break it.

episodes.title: Farewell, Seven Deadly Sins
episodes.summary: The world was trying to eliminate Meliodas, who became the new Demon King and became too powerful. Meliodas didn't tell anyone about the looming deadline.

episodes.title: Fated Brothers
episodes.summary: The curse on Elizabeth and Meliodas is still here. Which means the demon lord is still here.

episodes.title: The Final Battle
episodes.summary: The demon king, who revived using Zeldris as a substitute, and the demon beast Indura summoned by the demon king.

episodes.title: The Voice Calling Your Name
episodes.summary: Zeldris becomes even more powerful as the demon king. Then Escanor appeared to the "Seven Deadly Sins" in a difficult situation. Meliodas and Gowther invade the spiritual world of Zeldris, taking advantage of the good fight.

episodes.title: The King Sings Alone
episodes.summary: Diane`s technique "Mother Creation" finally succeeded in extinguishing the "Magic Lake" that was the source of the magical power of the Demon King. At the same time, it turns noon. The strongest minute for Escanor is here...!

episodes.title: The Struggle
episodes.summary: Escanor, who fights by converting all his vitality into magical power, approaches the Demon King. However, Meliodas stands in front of the deadly Escanor. It is because he realizes that he could lose his life.

episodes.title: Mortal Enemies
episodes.summary: The Demon King separates from the body of Zeldris and uses the land of Britannia as a new substitute, and undergoes a horrifying evolution. But they were convinced of their victory. Seven Deadly Sins believes in the bond with their friends and launches attacks all at once with a special move.

episodes.title: What the Witch Had Always Wanted
episodes.summary: "When the balance between light and darkness is lost, the age of the gods is over and the chaos revives. And the world will be reborn. "

episodes.title: A Taste of Chaos
episodes.summary: A secret feeling for Meliodas, and a resurgence of chaos to satisfy the hunger of the heart ... Merlin's aim revealed. In addition, the magical lake "Chaotic Priestess" begins to support Merlin's actions.

episodes.title: An Everlasting Kingdom
episodes.summary: Merlin, who has been separated from the "Seven Deadly Sins", confronts Cass alone to protect Arthur. Arthur also pulls out his sword and confronts Cass.

episodes.title: Heirs
episodes.summary: Series Finale
